answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: It sorts the problems into 'Fix before launch' (1–5, 'ranked by how likely each problem is to make a member fail'), 'Fix soon after', 'Smaller polish' and a 'Suggested order'. It says 'I didn't test with VoiceOver or TalkBack, and I didn't test real 200% zoom on a device' (the screen-reader notes come from the markup) and asks for the two journeys to be run 'on a real phone in dark mode with VoiceOver before opening reservations'.

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only at the last step, with no way to change the day
mapping.reason: The tool page accepts Monday 12 October, a closed day. It is refused only at the last step, after the details are filled in, and the message has no link back to change the day. That is D06.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date can be chosen and are never caught
mapping.reason: The calendar allows days 'before the tool is even back', and 'the tool not available yet case is never caught', so the reservation would be confirmed. That is D14.

mapping.title: The per-tool pick-up day and the basket session can contradict each other, with nothing flagging it
mapping.reason: The tool had a 12 October pick-up day, the basket accepted the 10 October session, and nothing flagged the clash. The confirm page can show both dates. That is D15: the day and the session are never reconciled.

mapping.title: An 8 px green dot is the only open-day marker on a phone
mapping.reason: At phone width the only sign of an open day is an 8 px dot, which is hard to see for older eyes. That is D20.

mapping.title: The 10-minute hold is hidden; once it lapses, Continue only says 'Something went wrong. Try again.'
mapping.reason: The basket shows no hold time ('Items are held for you while you finish'). After it expires, Continue gives a misleading generic error and offers no way forward. That is D10. The WCAG 2.2.1 point is about the same time limit.

mapping.title: Confirm stays active through a silent 1.5 s wait, so a double tap makes two reservations
mapping.reason: The button stays enabled and nothing visible changes. A double tap gave FT-4471 and FT-4472 for one drill. That is D12.

mapping.title: Continue on the basket page waits 1.2 s with no visible change
mapping.reason: This is not D12, which is another button on another page and causes duplicates, and not D10, which is the hidden hold and the misleading message. A member on a phone who taps Continue sees nothing change for over a second, so she cannot tell whether the tap registered and taps again or gives up.

mapping.title: The basket is not emptied after confirming, so the same tool can be confirmed again
mapping.reason: After confirming, the masthead still shows 'Basket (1)' and the same tool can be confirmed a second time. That is D18.

mapping.title: Truncated card names make the two drills look the same
mapping.reason: Names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…'. That is D03.

mapping.title: On phones, search sits below all ten cards and the filters hide behind an unlabelled three-line icon
mapping.reason: Below 480 px, search and filters are moved about 2,100 px down, under the cards, and the date filter sits behind an unlabelled icon that reads as a menu. That is D01.

mapping.title: The dark-mode 'Available from' badge is too faint (about 3.1:1)
mapping.reason: In dark mode, #2f7d4a on #1d2622 gives about 3.1:1, below the 4.5:1 needed for 16 px bold text. That is D04.

mapping.title: The 'Added to your basket' toast lasts 1.2 s with no link, and the basket count has scrolled out of view
mapping.reason: This is about the feedback after pressing 'Reserve this tool': a brief toast and nothing lasting in view. It does not say members will believe the tool is reserved, so it maps to D07 rather than D26.

mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list and says nothing
mapping.reason: Searching 'drill with two batteries' leaves the old list of 10 tools on screen, and the status message is never updated. That is D02.

mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase
mapping.reason: This is not in the ground truth; D02 covers only the missing no-match feedback. 'drill with two batteries' finds nothing even though that drill exists, so a member who describes a tool in her own words cannot find it, and this is the very choice the main journey depends on.

mapping.title: Sessions appear in reverse date order, so the visual order and the keyboard and screen-reader order disagree
mapping.reason: row-reverse with wrap-reverse puts 28 October at the top and 10 October at the bottom, while keyboard and screen-reader order stay chronological. That is D11.

mapping.title: The phone and membership number checks reject normal entries
mapping.reason: '07700 900 123', '+44 7700 900123' and 'ft-01234' are all rejected because nothing is normalised. That is D17.

mapping.title: The loan-length dropdown traps the keyboard
mapping.reason: Inside the open list Tab loops and Escape does not close it; tapping outside does not close it either. That is the D09 custom-listbox trap.

mapping.title: The three-tool limit is not enforced
mapping.reason: The 'up to three tools' rule is not enforced and all ten tools can be added. That is D21.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' is not announced, and focus jumps to 9 October
mapping.reason: The error is not linked to the calendar, so a screen-reader user hears only the date that focus jumps to. That is D19.

mapping.title: The results grid scrolls sideways at 320 px
mapping.reason: Because of minmax(330px, 1fr), 346 px of content sits in a 320 px window. That is D05.

mapping.title: The fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and desk phone number and can hide focused controls
mapping.reason: The bar covers the footer, including the desk phone number, and can hide keyboard-focused items (WCAG 2.4.11), because no padding keeps the page clear of it. That is D08.

mapping.title: 'Change' on the confirm page drops the chosen session
mapping.reason: The Change link goes back to the basket without the session already chosen. That is D13.

mapping.title: No skip link
mapping.reason: This is a bare checklist remark. The review shows no long block that keyboard users must get past on every page (the only masthead content it mentions is the basket count), so it shows no harm to these members.

mapping.title: The calendar does not show the month name
mapping.reason: This is not in the ground truth. The calendar is where members choose the pick-up day, and a grid of day numbers with no month leaves them to work out which month they are choosing, which is easy to get wrong when the month changes.

mapping.title: The done page gives neither the loan length nor a return date
mapping.reason: This is not in the ground truth. The done page is the member's record of the reservation. Without the loan length or a return-by date she cannot check which loan she chose or tell when the tool is due back.
